description: This file contains utility functions for managing local heavy check runtime operations, including environment variable handling, lock acquisition for local checks, and process management functionalities. It is used within the context of a larger build or testing system to coordinate heavy checks across multiple processes.

methods.name: isLocalCheckEnabled
methods.description: Checks if local check is enabled based on environment variables.

methods.name: hasFlag
methods.description: Determines if a given argument list contains a specific flag or argument.

methods.name: applyLocalTsgoPolicy
methods.description: Modifies environment and arguments to apply TSGO-specific policies for local execution.

methods.name: applyLocalOxlintPolicy
methods.description: Modifies environment and arguments to apply Oxlint-specific policies for local execution.

methods.name: acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock for heavy checks on the local machine, implementing lock file handling with timeout and process validation.

methods.name: resolveGitCommonDir
methods.description: Determines the common directory of the Git repository.
